{{Top}}
'''Lemnai''' were nocturnal creatures that lived on the plains of [[Vendaxa/Legends|Vendaxa]], a world known to have one of the densest ecosystems in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="CVD">''[[Star Wars: The Complete Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> The leathery-shelled creatures were a common prey of the [[Acklay/Legends|acklay]], who roamed the plains by day in search of lemnai asleep in their dens.<ref name="New EGAS">''[[The New Essential Guide to Alien Species]]''</ref>
